rules.key: fleet is worth over 750 points a Dread Archon must be included
rules.text: 1f the fleet is worth over 750 points a Dread Archon must be included to lead it.
rules.why: Kirjassa on painovirhe: lause alkaa '1f' eika 'If'. Se ei haittaa, koska kaava etsii osuman lauseen keskelta eika vaadi alkua.

rules.key: adds + 2 to its Leadership, to a maximum of 10
rules.text: You may include 1 Dread Archon in your fleet, who must be assigned to a ship and adds +2 to its Leadership, to a maximum of 10.
rules.why: Sijoittelu ja johtajuuden ylaraja ratkaistaan pelissa.

rules.key: Torture class cruisers may choose one of the following for the points shown
rules.text: Torture class cruisers may choose one of the following for the points shown: ... Prow Torpedoes +20 pts ... Phantom Lance +20 pts ... 1-2 Impaler Assault Modules +20 /+40 pts ... Launch Bays +40 pts
rules.why: Kirja sanoo 'one of the following', eli valinnat ovat toisensa poissulkevia. Sovellus tarjoaa ne aluksen profiilin optioina, joissa poissulkevuus on toteutettu; listariveina ne olisivat vain hintoja ilman ehtoa.

rules.key: escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2
rules.text: You may include any number of escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2-6 unless specified (see pg. 13).

rules.key: must contain at least three escorts for every capital ship taken
rules.text: However, Dark Eldar fleets must contain at least three escorts for every capital ship taken.
rules.why: Valvottu 9.9.2026 (kohta 8): kirjasta luettu saanto lisatty build_data.py:n RULE_PICKS-tauluun; resolveFleet tarkistaa sen. Aiempi puute: Suhdeluku VAHIMMAISMAARANA ja vastakkaiseen suuntaan: saattajia on oltava vahintaan kolme jokaista runkoalusta kohden. Moottorin ratio valvoo vain ylarajaa ('en

rules.key: Ships with launch bays may launch any mix of Raptor fighters
rules.text: Ships with launch bays may launch any mix of Raptor fighters, Razorwing bombers and Slavebringer assault boats.

rules.key: Leech torpedoes must be loaded with a separate reload ordnance roll
rules.text: Ships with torpedo tubes are armed with both Eldar torpedoes and Leech torpedoes, though the Leech torpedoes must be loaded with a separate reload ordnance roll as described in the special rules.
rules.why: Pelinaikainen saanto; sovellus tarjoaa rivin 'Leech torpedoes 0 pts' merkinnaksi.

notes: Listariveina EI ole Impaler Assault Module -vaihtoehtoa, ja se on oikein: kirjan rivi on '1-2 Impaler Assault Modules.........+20 /+40 pts', eli kaksi eri hintaa samalla rivilla. Sovellus tarjoaa ne aluksen profiilin optioina 'Impaler module I' ja 'Impaler module II', kumpikin 20 pts, mika vastaa kirjan sivun 352 sanamuotoa 'up to 2 Impaler assault modules for +20 each'.

Tama on ainoa lista jonka rivi kantaa yha hintataulukon silppua nakyvassa tekstissa: 'Torture class cruisers may choose one of the following for the points shown: 1-2 Impaler Assault Modules.........+20 /+40 pts ...'. Silppu on lauseen KESKELLA, ja sen siivoaminen veisi lauseen alusta itse saannon. Jatetty tarkoituksella.
Mimic Engines esiintyy kahdesti eri hinnalla: 20 pts runkoalukselle ja 5 pts saattajalle. Se on kirjassa, ei virhe.
'Dark Eldar fleets must contain at least three escorts for every capital ship' on listan tiukin rajoite eika se ole valvottavissa. Se kannattaa muistaa listaa rakentaessa.
